name: Short-link-2 3R whose J3 hub rides a spring-returned GH-concentric arc slide in link 2 (one-sided a2 relay, J2 on hard stops)
family: scheduled 4th coordinate: spherical 3R + passive arc relay on the ARM-side arc a2 (force-closed by J2 stops and one spring)
verdict: in progress: best 29.38 on Bench(60,160) fast (score 89.3), CMA gate passed on stream 3; frozen exact Bench(110,360) wear running

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R (J1, J2, J3 O20 hubs, MR117-2RS pairs) + ONE passive rotation about n = J2 x J3 through GH, built as a GH-concentric arc slot in the link-2a rail plate with a carriage on two M4 shoulder screws in iglidur flanged bushings (a sliding pair, not a bearing pair), spring-returned by one constant-force spring strip to its home stop, Hall-sensed (TMAG5170 class): the slide angle must be read to know the arm pose in modes B/C. J2 hard stops = two M2 dowels on link 1 (force closure: the stops + the spring determine the slide, R17 sag check in the model's statics()). bodies: link 1, link 2a (rail plate), carriage + J3 lower member (side 0) / link 2b (side 1), arm-end (hub 3 upper + K7 neck on BOTTOM). custom: base, link 1, rail plate, carriage, keeper plate, arm-end/neck, 3 hub shafts, spring drum (10); catalogue: 3 MR117 pairs (6), 2 iglidur bushings, 1 CF spring, 2 J2 stop dowels (11; sensor parts not counted).

limiter: hub 3 sits on the slot (F3 = rail 66 + 3.15: hub 3 in band 0.31 vs 0.87 for the plain 3R at the same seats); overhead ws 0/12 (hub 3 buried at elev 150: requirement 125-400 mm); near-touch: gap 53.76 if metal < 1 mm counts as contact

control_plain3r.note: Bench(60,160) fast; plain 3R = spine-parked-j2-3r.py at a1 42.143, a2 45.5057, same u1/u3, q 0.96, O20
